title: Head bounds after fuel capture
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be an input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $F$ whose work-tape heads all lie between $-N$ and $N$, inclusive. If the output of $c$ has length at most $N$, then in the captured fuel configuration for the constructed machine with body $B$, every work-tape head also lies between $-N$ and $N$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: each work-tape head of $c$ lies in $[-N,N]$
output length of $c$ is at most $N$
